name: Bookie Herod
summary: A leak has Lieutenant Doren searching his ranks for a traitor. Kurzen has learned Thorsen's secret, and Doren wants the records of Bookie Herod, Kurzen's logistics officer, from Kurzen's Compound.

sections.title: A Leak in the Ranks
sections.body: Lieutenant Doren suspects a traitor among his men. Kurzen learned Thorsen's secret, and the leak threatens their operations. So Doren needs to find its source. Thorsen kept a line into Kurzen's Compound through Bookie Herod, the colonel's logistics officer. Herod's written records may show how the operation was exposed.

sections.title: The Logistics Office
sections.body: Bookie Herod's papers are inside Kurzen's Compound. When Doren served under Kurzen, Herod's office was on the top floor of the compound's only two-story house. Supply requisitions and messages from Colonel Kurzen may reveal how Thorsen's secret was betrayed.

faq.answer: Bookie Herod is the logistics officer for Colonel Kurzen's men. He oversees supplies and camp operations at Kurzen's Compound. He once served as Thorsen's inside contact.

faq.q: Why does Lieutenant Doren want Herod's records?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Doren suspects a spy betrayed their camp after Colonel Kurzen learned Thorsen's secret. He hopes Herod's logistics logs and correspondence will show how the information leaked.

faq.q: Where are Bookie Herod's records located?
faq.answer: Herod's office is on the top floor of the only two-story house inside Kurzen's Compound. Doren believes his records are probably still there.
The investigation follows Jungle Secrets. There, Lieutenant Doren concludes that someone must have betrayed Thorsen's secret to Kurzen's men.

angles.text: Lieutenant Doren and his men once served under Colonel Kurzen before breaking away. Now they search their own ranks for a spy.
